verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's hybrid-search docs state that it provides "native reranking with managed models" alongside server-side RRF rank fusion. That directly covers built-in reranking. Its query docs also list late-interaction (ColBERT-style) multi-vector ranking as a native ranking option. Missing for 10: which reranking models are offered, the reranking API parameters, documented latency or quality behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration (the evidence is a single docs sentence).
